Solution 2 is wrong: its "19th term" is the n = 18 value, which Solution 3 lists as a(18), so it is the wrong index.

For Solutions 1 and 3, I could not recompute a(19) from scratch, so I used a congruence check. The values a(n) satisfy a(n) ≡ a(n−2) (mod 3). I checked this on small cases (n = 3 to 7) and on a(15) and a(17), where both have digit sum 118 and so are ≡ 1 (mod 3). Hence a(19) should be ≡ 1 (mod 3).

- Solution 1's value has digit sum 165, so it is ≡ 0 (mod 3). It fails the check, and the solution itself admits that its value does not pass its own consistency checks.
- Solution 3's value has digit sum 145, so it is ≡ 1 (mod 3). It passes. This is only a necessary condition, so my confidence in Solution 3 is moderate rather than certain.

VERDICT 1: REJECT
VERDICT 2: REJECT
VERDICT 3: ACCEPT
